summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EcoAndes new features batch: Analytics dashboard, WooCommerce-style orders management, SEO scores, multi-file upload, and first-party visit tracking. All backend APIs (14/14) and frontend features tested successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: Admin authentication working
Backend: POST /api/track/pageview stores visit with X-Forwarded-For header (83.56.20.10) and referrer (instagram.com) - returns {ok: true}
Backend: GET /api/admin/analytics/summary with date range (2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31) returns complete data structure (totals, series, sources, countries, referrers, pages)
Backend: GET /api/orders/admin/status-counts returns counts for all statuses including 'all'
Backend: GET /api/orders/admin/list supports all filter params (search, date_from, date_to, source, registered, customer_type)
Backend: POST /api/orders/admin/bulk-status successfully updates order status
Backend: POST /api/orders with acquisition data correctly stores source='google' and medium='organic' from referrer https://www.google.com/
Backend: POST /api/payments/stripe/checkout returns valid Stripe checkout URL (https://checkout.stripe.com/...)
Backend: GET /api/payments/stripe/status/{session_id} returns payment status successfully
Frontend: Storefront pageview tracking active (cookie banner dismissed, home and /tienda visited)
Frontend: Admin Dashboard - All 5 date preset buttons present (Hoy, 7 días, 30 días, 90 días, Este año)
Frontend: Admin Dashboard - Custom date inputs (Desde/Hasta) working
Frontend: Admin Dashboard - 4 KPI cards displayed (Visitas, Sesiones, Pedidos, Ingresos)
Frontend: Admin Dashboard - Visits evolution chart (Evolución de visitas) rendered
Frontend: Admin Dashboard - Interactive traffic map (Visitas por país) with SVG countries
Frontend: Admin Dashboard - Countries ranking panel (Países con más volumen) with flags
Frontend: Admin Dashboard - Acquisition sources panel (Resumen de adquisición) with source breakdown
Frontend: Admin Dashboard - Top pages panel (Páginas más vistas)
Frontend: Admin Orders - WooCommerce-style status tabs with counts (Todo, Pendiente, Pagado, Enviado, Completado, Cancelado)
Frontend: Admin Orders - Bulk actions toolbar (Acciones en lote select + Aplicar button)
Frontend: Admin Orders - Date filters (from/to inputs)
Frontend: Admin Orders - Channel filter (Todos los canales select)
Frontend: Admin Orders - Registered customer filter (Todos los clientes select)
Frontend: Admin Orders - Customer type filter (B2C/B2B select)
Frontend: Admin Orders - Search functionality (search input + Buscar pedidos button)
Frontend: Admin Orders - Order rows with checkbox, order link, eye preview icon
Frontend: Admin Orders - Origen column showing acquisition source (e.g., 'Orgánico: Google', 'Desconocido')
Frontend: Admin Orders - Preview modal opens with eye icon, shows order details, has close button and 'Ver ficha completa' link
Frontend: Admin Products - 174 SEO score dots with data-testid='seo-score-{sku}'
Frontend: Admin Products - SEO dots have data-seo-level attribute (baja/media/alta)
Frontend: Admin Products - Red dots (baja) showing correctly (AI SEO worker still processing - expected behavior)
Frontend: Admin Files - 'Subir imágenes' button with multiple attribute for multi-file selection
Frontend: Admin Files - 'Subir PDFs' button with multiple attribute for multi-file selection
Frontend: Admin Files - Filter tabs (Todos, Imágenes, PDFs) working
Frontend: Admin Files - Files count display showing '5 archivos'
Frontend: Admin Files - File cards grid displaying uploaded files
